content: Samuwela Enonu I Hol Deibid Kokowanaa

Inoke Yehoba i baek Samuwela elana i ba, “Sauga ana yapu ga ni ola ge nu lonuwanak Sol baena? Iyaka ya towani nige al na aawa kini ge Isileli ni lologugui-agil. He olibe enonona nu holek wam patuna toto sipi ali hon hi ginoliya nu pakalaopop, yaka nu ahe ge nu egon. Ya papatunawa nu na panuwa Bedeliyema tonowak Diyesi elana, kaiwena natunau bolau gamwaliyaa etega iyaka ya hile ni tabwa kin.”

Anana Samuwela i lahe i ba, “Nige bosowaina na ginol ola to! Ebo Sol wasau ni hago, nasi ni lopaaligau.” Inoke Yehoba i baek elana i ba, “Bulumwakau natuna yovana etega nu ahe ge alom nuku nok, yaka nu ba, ‘Ya nem na powon Yehoba elana.’
Diyesi ana baaba nu patuna ni nem powon ge enona elana, yaka abwe na ba elam hauna gun nu ginol. He natuna toto na pankitewa, enonu nu hol kokowanaa kaiweu.”
Yaka Samuwela i ginol i ola Yehoba hauna gun i baunan elana. Sauga i vin Bedeliyema, yaka tonowakiliyau hi nok elana ginebi wali ginu ge hi neli hi ba, “Wam nem eliyama ginebi ge wam laumwal?”

Yaka analiya i lahe i ba, “E, ginebi ge no laumwal. Ya nem na powon Yehoba elana. He nuku abubunimiu nuku yanayana tapwalolo kaiwena, yaka nuku nem alowau komiu ta na powon ge enona elana.” Inoke Diyesi alonau ge natunau bolau ali abububun paganina Samuwela i ginol, ge i ba heliya al nihi nok.
Sauga hi na hi vinan, yaka Samuwela matana i nok Eliyab i kite, iya Diyesi natuna tauina gamaun. Inoke i nuwatu i ba, “Tunahot Yehoba wana hilihili gamagalina te i taltalmilil Yehoba manininaa e.”

Yaa Yehoba i baek elana i ba, “Bahi nuwam ni nonoek ana awa ana waisi ge wana yapu elana, kaiwena iya iyaka ya towani. No hilihili nige i oola komiu gamagal wami hilihili. Komiu awa toto noleleya te ku gagayawa-an, yaa nau Yehoba ati te ya gagayawa-an.”
Inoke Diyesi Abinadab i yogaan ge i ba i nawa nok Samuwela manininaa. Yaa Samuwela i ba, “Iya al ge Yehoba nige i hihile.”
Yaka Diyesi i ba Sama i nawa nok Samuwela manininaa. Inoke Samuwela i ba, “Toto al ge Yehoba nige i hihile.”
Diyesi i giginol ola to, ana siga natunau bolau ali gewi seben hi nawa nok Samuwela manininaa. Yaa Samuwela i baek elana i ba, “Natumwau bolo ya nige etega Yehoba i hihile.”

Yaka i nel elana i ba, “Natumwau bolau ali gewi iyai ya e?” Anana Diyesi i lahe i ba, “Ali melumelu iyoho uleya, iya sipi i mamatahikagil.” Yaka Samuwela i baek elana i ba, “Ana baaba u patuna ni nem. Nige ta mimisiyo ge powon enona ta aan ana siga ni vin.”
Inoke Diyesi gamagal etega i patuna i na i en pwatanik elal. Tuwana i sapusapu ge maninina ana awa i waisi. Yaka Yehoba i baek Samuwela elana i ba, “He iya te, u nok ge enonu u hol kokowanaa.”

Inoke Samuwela olibe enonona ana patuna i ahe ge i hol Deibid kokowanaa talinau mataliyaa. Yaka Yehoba Yayaluwana wana gasisi i lau i minaa elana, i telipunaa lan o ge i nok. Yaka abwe Samuwela i sikal i na wana panuwaa Lama.
Deibid I Tuwalali Sol kaiwena
Yehoba Yayaluwana iyaka Sol i miluwai, ge yayaluwa toapapanak etega i noem Yehoba elana ge i papalovakuni.
Inoke wana totuwalali hi baek elana hi ba, “He yayaluwa toapapanak etega i noem Yabowaine elana ge i papalovakuniwa.

Tonowak, nu ba ama wam totuwalali naha na gamagal etega naha loyaan toto hapi ana galagalavenu i atena. Yaka ebo yayaluwa toapapanak wana gasisi ni mamasal eliyam, inoke hapi ni lolol ge amnam ni wawaisi.”
Inoke i baek elal i ba, “I waisi, nuku na gamagal etega nuku loyaan toto hapi ana lolol i atena bubun ge nuku en pwatanim elau.”

Yaka anana totuwalali avaliya etega i lahe i ba, “Diyesi Bedeliyema gamagalina natuna tauina etega ya kite, hapi ana lolol i atena. Iya tolohaveyan gasigasisena, toawabaaba ge i hebubun. He Yehoba i minaa elana.”
Yaka Sol elopapatuna i patunal hi na Diyesi elana ge hi ba, “Sol i ba natum Deibid, iya sipi ali tomatahikan, nu patuna elana.”
Inoke Diyesi Deibid i patuna i na Sol elana, ginebi donki etega beleid hi usan pwatanaa, oine patuna maisena ge goti natuna etega.
Sauga i vin, yaka Sol i ahe tukan i tabwa wana totuwalali. I nunuwana-an bubun, inoke abwe i hile i tabwa wana elohaveyan ana tokaval etega.
Yaka baaba i patuna Diyesi elana i ba, “Ya yaliyaya nabi Deibid kaiwena. Nu talamwan ni minaa elau ge ni tuwalali kaiweu.”
Sauga ebo yayaluwa toapapanak toto i noem Yabowaine elana wana gasisi i mamasal, yaka Deibid wana hapi i lolol, inoke yayaluwa toapapanak Sol i mimiluwai ge amnana i wawaisi al.
